item.title: GTA 6 Officially Passes a Massive Sales Milestone Just 1 Week In
item.description: We might have to stop saying something sold like hotcakes and start saying something sold like Grand Theft Auto 6 . Rockstar's latest has sold about as well as we expected, with estimates after only one week putting sales at over 50 million copies . That number will only go up in the weeks and months to come, especially if a new GTA Online mode and a PC version are eventually announced, as rumored .

item.title: GTA 6 Players Are Not, In Fact, Eating Good
item.description: There are countless ways to spend your time in Grand Theft Auto 6 . You can scoop up pricey bundles of cocaine in a seaplane, do deadlifts to get sick gains, and scuba dive to discover marine life and lost pirate treasure. You can steal an elderly woman's mobility scooter and go to a yard sale to find cool vintage T-shirts . But sadly, one thing you cannot do is savor a delicious meal, whether it's on a solo outing or even on a date night with Jason and Lucia. GTA 6 has a vast, deep world with astonishing attention to detail in almost every capacity. But there's one area where the game comes up surprisingly short — the food.

item.title: 'GTA 6' Fans Are Pulling Off Perfect Robberies With Only A Six Pack of Beer
item.description: If you're like me, then you approach Grand Theft Auto 6 's heists with anxiety. You case the joint inside and out. You plan meticulously, leaving the getaway car running nearby with the trunk open. You know exactly where all the cameras are, and have a plan for what to do if anyone tries anything funny. Well, what if I told you that you didn't need to do any of that to steal everything from a store in a way that inches your criminal profile closer to professional status?

item.title: 'Pokémon Winds and Waves' Fans Will End 2026 On A Good Note
item.description: Nintendo seems intent on letting The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time stay in the Switch 2 spotlight this year, so Pokémon fans still don't know when they'll be able to play Game Freak's next big RPG. Honestly, Pokémon Winds and Waves has been in a full-on information drought since the release of the reveal trailer back in early 2026 . Well, there's at least one thing fans have to look forward in the realm of pocket monsters now, and it's happening sooner than anyone expected.

item.title: Forza Horizon 6 Still Beats GTA 6 in One Key Way
item.description: "This taught us a huge amount about how to modify, design, and set up real cars to go fast and what happens to them when things go wrong, like bursting tires and crashing," Lyons told Polygon in a statement. (As if to underline the point, Lyons' LinkedIn profile pic shows him proudly holding up a blown racecar tire in a pit garage.) "We also took the same approach with rally-racing dirt bikes — it’s important to us to understand the difference between racing on two and four wheels and on- versus off-road so we can give our players as convincing authentic experience as we can," he said. "For this game, we completely rewrote the vehicle simulation for every vehicle type so we could add more detail and realism, as well as authenticity and believability, to the game."

item.title: 6 Upcoming Steam Games To Wishlist For Life After GTA 6
item.description: With December right around the corner, a very busy year for video games is coming to a close. And while some players might be spending that last month working through Grand Theft Auto 6 , there are still a few new PC games coming out before the calendar changes to 2027.

item.title: GTA 6 PC Port Takes a Massive Leap Forward in Just Days
item.description: Rockstar Games finally released Grand Theft Auto 6 this month after fans had waited 13 years . Unfortunately, PC players are still waiting as no PC port has been officially announced . But following the catastrophic leak of an apparent build of the game onto the internet, PC players have begun a race to create an unofficial version of GTA 6 . That race started slowly, but progress has been exponential in only a few days.

item.title: Gold treasure hours schedule in the Fortnite Chapter 7 mini season
item.description: Fortnite is continuing the tradition of special Saturday hourly events during the Chapter 7 mini season , though this time they're treasure hours , centered around the pirate-themed "Treasure Hunters" season. During these hours, certain sprites will get increased drop rates, and you'll drop into the game with special items.

item.title: UFO location and alien encounter walkthrough in GTA 6
item.description: The Grand Theft Auto 6 UFO alien abduction encounter is the beginning of a very peculiar optional mission, which will eventually have you gallivanting all of Leonida in search of a mysterious building. It all starts when you investigate an abandoned car at the side of the road, but this can happen in multiple different locations, so you need to know where to go, and where to find the building shown to you in a dream after that.

item.title: 'Buffy the Vampire Slayer' Star Reveals His 5 Favorite Episodes
item.description: Almost three decades after the show first debuted, Marsters remains one of the best parts of any Buffy rewatch. So when I got him on the phone recently to reflect on the show's fan-favorite musical episode , I took the chance to ask the Spike actor for his five favorite episodes of all time.
